items.headline: Manchester United draw 2-2 with Everton in Premier League match
items.summary: United played Everton to a 2-2 draw. Marcus Rashford won the Player of the Match vote and Bruno Fernandes was named August's Player of the Month.

items.headline: Manchester United submit Champions League squad for 2026/27 season
items.summary: United have officially filed their squad registration for the UEFA Champions League. Next match is against Sabah.

items.headline: Premier League squad confirmed for 2026/27
items.summary: Manchester United have confirmed their Premier League squad list for the 2026/27 season.
